title: Russian Spacecraft Nears Satellite Used by Ukraine
excerpt: A Russian spacecraft has maneuvered into extreme proximity to the ICEYE-X36 satellite utilized by Ukraine.
body_html: A Russian spacecraft has executed maneuvers bringing it into extreme proximity with a satellite utilized by Ukraine. According to available details, the spacecraft known as Kosmos 2612 traveled from hundreds of kilometers away to close in on the ICEYE-X36 satellite.
